question.text: An LVF for accredited investors may be permitted to extend its tenure by up to how many years?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (AIF) (Fourth Amendment) Regulations, 2024, LVFs may extend tenure up to 5 years with two-thirds unit-holder approval by value. The Trap: 2 years is for standard Cat III; 3 years is not prescribed; unlimited extension is never permitted. Cross-Exam Context: LVFs enjoy the same 5-year extension latitude for Cat I/II under XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Document the LVF's 5-year extension eligibility in the PPM to avoid ambiguity at tenure-end.
